sources.title: Clinical evaluation of software (MDR Art. 61 / MDCG 2020-1)
sources.why: Clinical performance must be proven in the target population, so validation samples must represent the intended users.

sources.title: IVDR — in-vitro diagnostic software (Regulation (EU) 2017/746)
sources.why: IVD performance evaluation requires clinical performance evidence drawn from a population representative of intended use.
